'''Ebruchese''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] used by the [[Ebruchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Ebruchi [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ness (pirate)|Ness]], [[Lugubraa]] elder [[Lorgrombo]], and the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]] member [[Blessed Toxmalb]] spoke Ebruchese.<ref name="TUR" />
